welcome.title: About Us
welcome.body: The Church of the Gospel of Christ in Bitola is a place where people find peace, hope, and community in Christ. You are welcome to join us.

cta.title: Join Us
cta.body: Every Sunday we welcome you with open hearts. Write to us or come visit.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn about our community
about.metaDescription: Learn about the Church of the Gospel of Christ in Bitola — our story, mission, values, and faith.

intro.heading: Our Story
intro.body: The Church of the Gospel of Christ in Bitola is a community of believers who gather to worship God, study His Word, and support one another in faith and daily life.
intro.body2: For many years our doors have been open to everyone seeking peace, hope, and a deeper relationship with God. We welcome you to learn more about who we are.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: Our mission is to share the Gospel of Jesus Christ, to nurture a warm and welcoming community, and to encourage every person to grow in faith through the study of Scripture and a life of prayer.

love.title: Love
love.body: We strive to reflect the love of Christ in how we treat one another and everyone who walks through our doors.

community.title: Community
community.body: We believe faith grows best in fellowship, where people support, encourage, and pray for each other.

word.title: The Word
word.body: Scripture is the foundation of our life and worship, guiding our decisions and shaping our hearts.

beliefs.heading: What We Believe
beliefs.item1: We believe in one God, the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
beliefs.item2: We believe the Bible is the inspired Word of God.
beliefs.item3: We believe salvation is a gift of grace through faith in Jesus Christ.
beliefs.item4: We believe the Church is a community called to love and serve.

visit.heading: Come Visit Us
visit.body: We would love to meet you. Reach out with any questions or simply join us for a service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How the Church of the Gospel of Christ in Bitola handles your personal information.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how we handle the information you share with us when you visit our website or contact us. We are committed to protecting your privacy and using your information responsibly.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.body: When you contact us through the website, we collect the name, email address, and message you provide. We do not collect this information for any purpose other than responding to you.

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use the information you share solely to respond to your messages and requests. We never sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

cookies.heading: Cookies and Analytics
cookies.body: Our website may use essential cookies and privacy-friendly analytics to understand how the site is used and to improve it. These do not identify you personally.

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: We rely on trusted service providers for hosting and email delivery. These providers only process information as needed to operate the website and are bound by their own privacy commitments.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.body: You may ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information you have shared with us at any time. We will respond to your request as soon as we reasonably can.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us using the details on our Contact page.
